author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The SCINTIX P4 is a compact compute module developed by RELOC around Espressif’s ESP32-P4 microcontroller, using the 55 × 40mm form factor of Raspberry Pi CM4 and CM5 modules. title: RISC-V compute module brings ESP32-P4 to Raspberry Pi CM4/CM5 carriers

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Orange Pi has published hardware details for the OrangePi O1, a 90 × 70mm SBC based on the Sophgo BM1688 processor. It pairs eight Arm Cortex-A53 cores with a RISC-V C906 coprocessor and a 16-TOPS INT8 TPU, along with up to 16GB of LPDDR4/LPDDR4X memory. title: (Updated) 16-TOPS AI SBC with SATA 3.0 runs on octa-core Sophgo BM1688

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The MINIX T4000/T5000 is a compact AI workstation based on NVIDIA’s Jetson AGX Thor platform, combining Blackwell GPU architecture with Arm Neoverse-V3AE processors. The system supports up to 128GB of LPDDR5X memory, dual 10GbE networking, PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage, and Ubuntu 24.04 for local AI inference and development. title: Compact AI workstation runs Ubuntu on Jetson AGX Thor with dual 10GbE

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Agilex 2X is Altera’s latest FPGA and SoC portfolio, consisting of four device families for applications ranging from industrial control to high-performance computing. The first announced family, Agilex 27, incorporates 256Gbps transceivers, PCIe 7.0 support, and a distributed HyperFlow data network. title: Agilex 2X FPGA portfolio supports PCIe 7.0 and QuartusIQ AI design tool
